name: BBQ Pulled Pork
subtitle: Slow-cooked seasoned pork finished with thick barbecue coating.
description: This is a simple pulled-pork method using a seasoned barbecue-onion base with two pork pieces cooked low and slow, then shredded and tossed in additional sauce.

instructions.text: In a large pot or oven-safe vessel, combine the barbeque sauce with the dry onion soup mix to make a coating.
Add the boneless pork loin roast and the thick country-style pork ribs and mix until both cuts are coated.
Cook covered with low heat until the pork is fork-tender, about 420 minutes, and the internal temperature reaches 145°F. If using a thermometer, hold and allow the meat to rest at least 3 minutes.
Transfer to a board or tray, shred the roast and ribs into strands using forks, and let the meat rest.
Return shredded meat to the cooking vessel and stir in barbeque sauce.
Add another portion of the barbeque sauce, stirring again to fully coat.
Continue cooking and stirring occasionally so the coating thickens and everything is evenly moistened.

equipment: large pot or oven-safe covered dish
